IHC Lymphoma Panel

IHC No- 742/2024
Gross :-  IHC performed on one block no. VH 135/24
Clinical Details : Lymphoproliferative disorder
IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY RESULTS

IHC MARKER(S)                      RESULT
CD 3 Non-Immunoreactive, score 0 in the lesional cells
CD 20 Immunoreactive, score 4+ in the lesional cells
Ki-67 Immunoreactive in 15-20 % of the lesional cells
CD 10 Immunoreactive, score 2+ in the lesional cells
CD 79a Immunoreactive, score 3+ in the lesional cells
CD 5 Non-Immunoreactive, score 0 in the lesional cells
BCL 6 Immunoreactive, score 2 + in the lesional cells
BCL2 Immunoreactive, score 2 + in the lesional cells

IMPRESSION- Immunohistomorphology findings favour Follicular Lymphoma , Low grade ( grade 1-2)
Comments : Advised clical correlation and molecular studies.

All controls showed reactivity.
INTERPRETATION

             RESULT   SCORE      
Non immunoreactive 0
Immunoreactive in 1-25 % cells 1+
Immunoreactive in 26-50% cells 2+
Immunoreactive in 51-75% cells 3+
Immunoreactive in 76-100% cells            4+


 Notes :
 1. This test was performed on paraffin embedded tissue section.
2. Detection system used – Biogenex  Real Envision Detection system, peroxidase/ DAB + Rabbit/mouse.
3. The impression is based on the material submitted and is not a complete surgical pathlogy report.
4. Improper Fixation may affect results. 
5. This assay has not been validated on decalified tissue. Results should be interpreted with caution given the likelihood or false negativity of decalcified specimen.
 Fixative requirement :
 1. The volume of formalin fixative should be atleast 10 times the volume of the specimen
2. Specimens should be immersed in 10% neutral buffered formalin within 1 hours of the biopsy/ resection procedure ( time of removal and time of immersion to be mentioned )
3. In all resection (large) specimens , the tumour must be bisected prior to immersion in fixative
